## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slender woman with milk-white skin, a pretty nose, and large, expressive gray-green eyes that shift with emotion. Her most distinguishing feature is her thick, radiant red-auburn hair, which she wore in plaits in her youth. Though she had a light dusting of freckles upon her nose as a child, her delicate features and glowing complexion give her a striking, ethereal look.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032), [v2 c27 P41](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0041), [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c41 P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015), [v4 c1 P25](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0025), [v4 c12 P21](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0021), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)_

## Personality

Nell possesses an exceptionally vivid imagination and a deep capacity for romance, often drifting into reveries and dramatic daydreams. Highly affectionate, loyal, and empathetic, she holds strong feelings for her friends and maintains an intense, passionate nature that can occasionally flare into a swift temper or held grudges. She is determined, ambitious, and philosophical, meeting both triumphs and trials with resilience and a warm sense of humor.

- bring beauty and community improvements through the Improvers society  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>

## History

Orphaned in infancy when both her parents died of fever, Nell was taken in by Mrs. Thomas and later lived upriver with Mrs. Rudge, assisting with young children. Following a brief stay in an orphan asylum at Marden, she was brought to Grey Shutters by Obed and Thirza Abernethy, where she found a loving home. Nell attended school at Brierley, engaging in intense academic competition with Hugh Carrow and forming lifelong bonds with Isolde Pembroke and other local youths. She co-founded and served as secretary for the Brierley Village Improvement Society while pursuing her studies at Regent's Academy. Nell went on to attend Wexcombe College, excelling in English and winning a prize for her short story writing. After working as a teacher for three years, she married her former academic rival Hugh Carrow and became a mother.
